correctness.rationale: Starting from 010, a length-one duplication introduces an absorbing 00 prefix. Any final 01-prefix path therefore uses only length-two 01 or length-three 010 prepends; both preserve 010. The successive gap lengths 2 or 3 between new 1 symbols before the fixed suffix uniquely decode all blocks and derivations, so every path has one step per new 1 and the exact (1-uz^2-uz^3)^(-1) series. The Fibonacci suffix recursion and avoidance of 000,11 establish the same-parity corollary. The two bound-four witnesses are valid. Independent full prefix-duplication enumerations for four seeds confirm finite cases, not the infinite proof.
